scope: offline disposable SQLite and fake RPC; no services, real databases, chain state, signing, website or public calls touched

negative_control.result: expected failure reproduced from isolated original baseline module, without reverting or editing the working tree
negative_control.note: Supersedes the earlier conversation-only reproduction limitation. The 12 failed subcases remain 2 test methods, not 12 distinct method counts.

verification.scope: Final monitor source; test file before addition of the two further boundary methods; original output in conversation.

Only two new boundary methods and one real SQLite-to-API fixture integration. Frontend history test file has unrelated pre-existing drafts and is included by exact hash, not claimed as published baseline.

observed_assertions.outage_or_malformed_at_tip_or_deeper: Logical database dump and cursor exactly unchanged after failure; not a bytewise WAL backup claim.
observed_assertions.real_shallow_reorg: Atomic orphan deletion and cursor rollback followed by confirmed re-index succeeds.
observed_assertions.start_anchor: Full bounded rollback requires the original explicit start parent; missing/changed anchor or changed genesis preserves history.
observed_assertions.concurrency: Rollback takes BEGIN IMMEDIATE and compares the read plan/cursor before deleting; normal process lock remains required.
observed_assertions.depth_boundary: Exactly two removed blocks accepted at depth two; existing three-block rejection retained.

review_limits: RPC/provider completeness and actual finality remain trusted external boundaries. A malicious provider can fabricate a self-consistent chain; these checks do not constitute consensus proofs or independent production qualification.
